You should be very cautious about drinking alcohol while taking metronidazole. Mixing alcohol with this medication can cause a severe reaction known as a disulfiram-like reaction, which can lead to nausea, vomiting, and a rapid heart rate. It is best to avoid alcohol entirely while you are on this antibiotic. If you are unsure, please consult with your pharmacist or doctor for personalized advice.
